A.title: Slick Roots
A.text: The roots make a stair here. They are wet and they hold. Mind the third one down, it rolls. Rhee's scout found that out for us.

Y.title: Carved in the Vine Hall
Y.text: Not every bright flower is food. The red ones breathe back at you. The pale ones are only flowers. Learn which before you reach for either.

R.title: The Quiet Hunter
R.text: Up above, the first hunters left a note about waiting. Stay still and the beasts forget you are meat. Move at the right moment, and only once.

G.title: Wreath of Vines
G.text: Someone twisted these vines into a ring and hung it low, so a tall delver has to bow. We took it for manners. It may have been a snare.

M.title: Bark Tally
M.text: Rows of cuts in the trunk, same hand, same blade. Seven hunters on floor 12. This tally runs past forty. Somebody kept counting after the others stopped.

O.title: Light Gives Out Here
O.text: The black leaves close over the canopy lamps one by one. By the third day we climbed by touch. Keep a hand on the wall and a count of your steps.

U.title: Names on the Trunk
U.text: The old trees keep scars, and the scars keep names. Most are worn smooth. One is fresh and says only: Hale's boy was here. He was twelve.

X.title: Last Mark of a Hunter
X.text: Whoever cut this had little time. Three words: it is patient. Under that, a long scratch where the knife slipped and did not try again.

?.title: The Hunter's Question
?.question: The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
